scenes.motion: receipt-style line-item stack: row 1 pop-in (muted/accent chip '1x'), '+' divider fade, row 2 pop-in (warning-tone chip '+1x' with warning glyph), horizontal rule draw, '=' + '2x' total pop with glow — then whole stack scales/fades out overlapping scene-reveal entrance

shot_brief: A ~9.5s purple/black motion graphic literalizing 'pay once, pay twice.' Beat 1: a wry hook line slides/fades in — the cheapest bid isn't always the smartest. Beat 2 (dominant motif): a receipt-style cost stack tallies two line items — THE CHEAP JOB at 1x, plus TO FIX IT LATER at +1x (warning-toned, with a small warning glyph) — summing visibly into a bright 2x total. Beat 3: that total explodes into the hero payoff type YOU PAY TWICE. in bright accent with a supporting line CHEAP ISN'T ALWAYS SMART., freeze-held to the end for a clean cut back to host footage. Generic 1x/+1x/2x multiplier tokens stand in for unspecified dollar figures — the point is the repetition, not a number. Scene boundaries overlap by ~0.5-0.6s (crossfade, never a hard cut) so no frame is ever blank against the alpha-overlay export.
